therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-1 checkpoint inhibition combined with MDSC depletion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced T-cell anti-tumor immunity through checkpoint blockade and reduction of immunosuppressive myeloid cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximally Tolerated Dose and Recommended Phase 2 Dose

results.effect_size: MTD/RP2D: Pembrolizumab 200mg Q3W + ATRA 150mg/m2 x 3 days
results.target_engagement_evidence: MDSC frequency decreased by 48.6% in responding patients vs increased 109.7% in non-responding patients
biomarker_changes: Responding patients showed 48.6% decrease in MDSC frequency
Non-responding patients showed 109.7% increase in MDSC frequency
subgroup_findings: Responding patients had significant MDSC depletion (-48.6%)
Non-responding patients had increased MDSC levels (+109.7%)
results.dose_information: Pembrolizumab 200mg Q3W + All-Trans Retinoic Acid 150mg/m2 orally for 3 days surrounding each of the first four pembrolizumab infusions
